fusions.name: Guard's Lunge
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 12 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target with your weapon and deals 28 damage that ignores armour, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Barding for Two
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and raises your armour by 10% for 6 seconds. A barded hound escort fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Takes the Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. The effect grows 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
